name: 幻影灵菇
evolution: 小灵菇 → 幻灵菇 Lv.20 → 幻影灵菇 Lv.32
description: 仅仅看到它触角上闪烁的荧光就会头痛难耐，对其研究很难有进展。没有生命迹象但是可以自如活动，无法判定是植物还是动物，唯独颈间圆环中似乎蕴含强大生命力。
descriptionEn: Merely seeing the flickering light on its antennae causes an unbearable headache, making research on it hard to advance. It shows no signs of life yet moves freely; whether it is plant or animal cannot be determined — only the ring around its neck seems to contain powerful vitality.
